rules.statement: The burden of proof is on the creditor to prove the execution of a mortgage bond, and the sum due thereunder, even if the debtor has admitted the amount owed.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where a creditor on a bond asks for a hypothecary decree against property title to which has passed to a third party by a subsequent transfer by the mortgage debtor, he has to prove the fact of the mortgage, that it was executed to secure the repayment of money due to him, that the debt was not repaid, and that a definite sum of money is due to him on the bond."
